errors.text_span: 提供的图像展现了一个在视觉上整体呈对角线倾斜放置的组合图表
errors.evidence: The chart is not visually tilted or diagonally placed; it is aligned horizontally.
The tallest bars in mid-to-late July reach approximately 1,400,000, not 1,200,000–1,300,000.
The shortest bars in late August are closer to 200,000–300,000, not 400,000–500,000.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart shows the relationship between daily global COVID-19 cases and related news media reports.
The description does not mention the synchronization and lagging patterns between the two data series, which are highlighted in the reference.
The description does not mention the weekly intervals on the x-axis, which are explicitly labeled in the chart.
The description does not mention the step intervals of 200,000 for the left y-axis and 1,000 for the right y-axis.
The description does not mention the overall trend of the blue line (news reports) and its correlation with the bar heights (COVID-19 cases).
